reviews.text:
We have tried other boarding/grooming services and can honestly say that Pet Care Plus is our favorite place to take our dog, Toby. We started him off with the Prestige Training and could not be happier with the results.
Toby is so excited to go to Pet Care Plus that we can't say the word "Daycare" without him going nuts.

I sent my 5-year-old Golden, Sherman, to Prestige Pet Care for a two-week board and train program to work on his reactivity. I was nervous about being separated from him for that long, but the team—and especially Alya, who handled his training—was incredible! They took excellent care of him, kept me updated every step of the way, and made unbelievable improvements in his behavior. We also rely on Pet Care Plus for his boarding and daycare needs, and they've been just as fantastic. I highly recommend Prestige to anyone on the fence. They truly care about the animals, and Sherman will definitely be back!

Highly recommend. I boarded my dog, Bruno, here for a week, and I couldn't be happier with the experience! The staff sent fantastic updates throughout his stay, which gave me total peace of mind while I was away. They took wonderful care of him and were extremely responsive and attentive to every message.

A massive thank you to Jennifer and the entire team at Pet Care Plus for taking such wonderful care of our three dogs during their four-night stay!

One of the biggest compliments we can give is how our dogs were when we picked them up: they were happy and excited to see us, but they weren’t frantic, stressed, or desperate to leave. They clearly felt comfortable and well cared for while they were there, and that gave us so much peace of mind.

Every interaction with the staff reinforced that feeling. From the handlers who greeted our dogs and brought them back at drop-off to the concierge team at the front desk, everyone was knowledgeable, warm, confident, and clearly experienced with dogs. The entire team made us feel like our dogs were known, understood, and in very capable hands.

We will absolutely be bringing our dogs back to Pet Care Plus, and we’ll continue recommending them and sending more business their way. Knowing we have a place where we can leave all three of our dogs and actually enjoy our trip without worrying about them means more than we can say.

Thank you again, Pet Care Plus, for continuing to give us every reason to feel confident leaving our dogs in your care. Five stars without hesitation!

We have our puppy, at PCP, and couldn’t be more happy! From the first day, they knew her name and are always so happy to see her. We feel great dropping her off for daycare or boarding, and know that she is in great hands and also has an amazing time!
Staff was attentive and brought issues to my attention immediately for my limited mobility pup.   Friendly and helpful staff!
Thank you, Phillip, for taking the time to leave us a rating. We appreciate your support for Pet Care Plus!
A home away from home for my dog! He loves it so I do too!
The team at Pet Care Plus took such good care of my cat Chotu while he recovered from surgery! They are thoughtful, competent, responsive, caring, and enthusiastic. I highly recommend this business!
Found my bubba a good home and I know he enjoyed the staff as much as the staff loved him 10000/10 highly recommended
My dogs always look so cute after their grooming appointments! I’m always so happy with how their haircuts turn out.

Hosted my dog’s birthday party here and everyone was incredible! Great communication leading up to the party, everyone was helpful and friendly, and they adapted from our outdoor plan to bring the party inside when a thunderstorm came (which was very appreciated by some sensitive pups). Can’t recommend more for a dog party both humans and dogs can enjoy! Thank you for everything!

Hi Rubi,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We take all concerns seriously. We’re unable to locate a client or reservation under your name in our system, and we’d appreciate the opportunity to learn more. Please contact us directly with the date of your visit so we can look into this further.

My fur kiddo had a wonderful time during his first visit yesterday at Pet Care Plus. The staff were very kind and so patient with Ru! The property is clean and it felt safe. Our little one was so spoiled at he previous daycare in Houston. They set the bar high, so his dad and I are so thankful! It is very reassuring and we can rest easy knowing that when he is in their care, he is in fully capable and caring hands. He will be coming for some social time once to twice a week for sure.

I used to love this place but recently there’s been a change of staff and the quality has plummeted. The old staff were kind, attentive, and always had something nice to say about people’s dog. These new faces don’t even act like they want to be there. Also, maybe they forget that we can watch the cameras too because I’ve seen some questionable behavior from them, not with only my dog but others. I hope yall are checking those cameras and checking them OFTEN.
My dog used to love going here and then he started acting scared and wasn’t enjoying it anymore so we stopped going. I guess I’d recommend it if you don’t care about your dog that much, but I don’t play about mine so we found somewhere else to go. Also, pcp is too expensive for the low quality of service they’re providing now. Really disappointed because like I said we used to love this place.

Hi Patrick, thank you so much for the kind review! We love having your sweet Mabel with us and always look forward to her visits. It means the world to our team to know you enjoy our services. We'll be looking forward to seeing you both again soon!
Pine loves daycare and boarding here - runs right in! Never have seen such a great team

Took our puppy here for daycare last week. We loved that PetCare shared updates and report Card on her during the day. Everyone was so kind and genuinely cared about the pets they took care of. Wonderful experience, we will be booking with them again.

Our dog Teemo regularly gets haircuts here!
His usual groomer, Gina, always makes sure he is properly cared for. And he looks so spiffy with the new handkerchief they give him every time.

Wait times can be a bit long though, and sometimes you need to leave your dog there for a long time for a haircut (4-6 hours).

I cannot say enough great things about Pet Care Plus. From the moment you walk through the doors, you can feel the culture of care, kindness, and professionalism they have created. This is not just a business that watches dogs, it is a place that genuinely loves and values every little puppy that comes through their doors.

Jennifer, the owner, has built something truly special. Her leadership and heart for both the animals and the people around her are obvious in every interaction. You can tell the team is cared for, supported, and encouraged, and that positive culture flows directly into the way they treat every pet. It is rare to find a place where the staff is this attentive, patient, and genuinely excited to see your dog each day.

As a pet owner, there is incredible peace of mind knowing your dog is in a safe, loving, and uplifting environment.

Chicago is lucky to have a place like Pet Care Plus. Highly recommend to anyone looking for people who will truly care for their pets like family.

We cannot say enough amazing things about Pet Care Plus and the incredible care they provided for our dog, Kimble, while we traveled across the world for our honeymoon. Leaving your fur baby behind for that long is never easy, but the team made us feel completely at peace from the very beginning.

One of the things that stood out immediately was that they allowed us to tour the facility before boarding. That transparency and care made such a difference in helping us feel comfortable and confident in our decision.

The staff also took the time to help us fully customize Kimble’s stay to best fit his personality and needs. They walked us through package options and helped us add things like private swims, additional walks, and grooming to make his stay as enjoyable and comfortable as possible.

Kimble has a pretty rigorous medication schedule, and handling that properly was one of our biggest priorities when choosing a boarding facility. The team handled it flawlessly, which gave us so much peace of mind while we were overseas.

What truly brought me to tears, though, was the level of compassion they showed when Kimble got nervous and started hunger striking a bit. Instead of just noting that he wasn’t eating, they actually took the time to hand feed him twice daily to make sure he was cared for and comfortable. That kind of love and attention goes so far beyond standard boarding care, and it meant the world to us.

Another highlight of every single day of our trip was receiving Kimble’s daily report card. Seeing photos of him and hearing little updates about his day genuinely became one of the best parts of our honeymoon.

When we picked him up, he smelled AMAZING, was so fluffy and handsome after his grooming appointment, and even came home wearing the cutest little bandana. They also gave us an adorable goodie bag for his first stay, which was such a thoughtful touch.

This team truly treats your pets like family, and we are beyond grateful for the care, kindness, and love they showed Kimble. We would recommend them to absolutely anyone looking for a boarding facility they can fully trust.
Thank you so much for 5 stars. So glad to see that Maya's stay was a good experience. We look forward to seeing you both soon!
gina has groomed my dog remi since she stared going to the groomer she does an amazing job

****Long Post Alert ****

I was visiting Chicago and decided to drop my furbaby off for a day at Pet Care Plus as it looked nice and somewhere I could trust to watch my love bug. I read the mixed reviews and still decided to try them out.

The front desk receptionist Janine (might be the wrong spelling) was super nice and understanding as this was my first time ever leaving my fur baby anywhere besides the groomer.

However, the resort manager Kate was rude, unpleasant, not understanding, and simply rushed me out the door. I had no time to let her know anything about my boy because he is a velcro pup and is more of a people's pup than being around his own kind.

Her look was not reassuring but more like, ok bye we got it from here. She just kept saying we got him he will be ok and walked off. No introduction as to who she was and no greeting to me, snow, or my daughter that was with me during the drop off.

I stayed for an extra 10 minutes just to check things out. I downloaded the app to see the cameras which only 2 were visible. I noticed snow in the area with all the dogs and a few were trying to mount him. He is a small pup and has high anxiety.

I immediately requested he be taking out as that was overwhelming for him as it was to me just looking at it. Dewayne, I don't know his title, but he kept snow in the kitchen with him. I thanked him for that.

I wasn't able to see that area as several areas are not visible which defeats the purpose of having cameras and we can't access All areas where Our family might be. All in all they sent a report card stating snow was doing good and such a sweet pup.

I want be returning when I visit again based off the initial encounter. The vibe wasn't giving Spa or Resort, but each customer is different and might enjoy it there, its just not for us.

We had our pup Lux stay at Pet Care Plus for their three-week Board & Train program, and he truly had the time of his life! We could see it ourselves by checking the cameras they provide for pet parents to watch their dogs play throughout the day. That’s one feature I absolutely love and always tell people about, since so many places don’t offer it. The staff is incredibly kind, helpful, and clearly experts when it comes to working with dogs. We felt so comfortable leaving Lux in their care and are already booking our next boarding!

Returned another time to Pet Care Plus for our dog’s grooming
We had Caila again
Sweet kind insightful
Ray felt so soft

We had a good experience boarding our cat here. We got a few photos while we were away, and she looked happy and relaxed. I really liked that she was able to roam around and play.

The only small issue was that her feeding times were changed a bit, even though I left pretty specific instructions. It wasn’t a huge deal, but it took a few days to get her back on her normal schedule once we got home.

Overall, we’re happy with the care she received.
Gina is an absolute pro!

Great place, amazing staff, I felt the love they all had for animals. My Rough Collie Bocce was groomed perfectly. Thank you for giving me a tour of the facility as well. Can't wait to bring him back.

I rented the pool to celebrate my pup’s birthday and host a Great Dane meet-up, and it was a really fun experience. The dogs had an amazing time - honestly, it’s one of the best dog pools I’ve seen in Chicago. The design is especially thoughtful: no steep stairs or jumping required, just a gradual slope that lets dogs ease in and get comfortable on the shelf before swimming.

The two-hour private rental was definitely on the pricey side, though it did feel worth it if you’re able to swing it. The front area is very well maintained and clean, it smells more like a spa than a kennel, which really sets the space apart.

That said, I’d recommend checking out their daycare pool-friendly days in the summer as a more cost-effective option versus a private rental. Overall, a really well-done space and a special experience for dogs.
My pet loves going to day care here.  They even made him a little goodie bag and printed a photo of him for his first day!  Highly recommend!

My first time at Pet Care Plus and I’m very happy with the service at this grooming salon. They did a great job cutting Ronero’s hair and made the whole experience easy and pleasant. The staff was kind, friendly,  professional, and clearly cares about the pets. They had a sign welcoming my baby which I thought it was so thoughtful. Highly recommend!
We are so happy to have found Da Vinci Paws this year. Everyone is fantastic and our dogs are so well cared for. Thank you!
They accommodated my last minute booking flawlessly! Super grateful for Zoe for being so helpful during the whole process. 10/10 would recommend!

My family has been a loyal customer of PCP for over four years, and during that time, we've appreciated the care, professionalism, and genuine affection your team has shown toward our dog. It is clear that your staff truly enjoys what they do, and our dog has always been happy and excited to visit, which has meant a great deal to us. Up until late October 2025, we would have given PCP 5 stars (and we've recommended PCP via word of mouth to multiple friends in the neighborhood).

*However* , we were very surprised and disappointed to see the recent changes to the boarding structure and the accompanying price increase of over 25% for what amounts to the same service (a nightly stay with morning and afternoon play). There was not clear communication about this change (it was only vaguely alluded to deep down in a monthly email, with no specifics). There was no notice explaining the new model or providing any context for the increase. After years of loyalty and trust, this lack of transparency is incredibly frustrating and disappointing. Frankly it just feels like a money grab. (And I won't mention, beyond this one sentence, the credit card surcharge that just feels nickel-and-dimey.)

We find the new Bronze boarding package confusing and impractical. It does not make sense to put our dog in boarding only for him to play for three hours a day and then remain in his room until the next morning. That is not consistent with the level of care and enrichment we've come to expect from PCP.

We understand that prices can rise over time (we see it every day at restaurants the grocery store, and with other consumer products/services), but a change of this size and nature should be communicated clearly and thoughtfully to long-term clients. Without proper notice or explanation, it's difficult to continue feeling confident in the fairness and value of the service.

Many other / larger businesses implement price increases on a regular cadence, maybe 2-3%, twice a year. Never 30% overnight. And playing catch-up is not an excuse.

We wanted to share this feedback directly because we have genuinely valued PCP and the care our dog has received. That said, given how this situation was handled (and what the new prices are), we are exploring other options for boarding and daycare, and will likely not bring our dog back to PCP for those services unless boarding pricing and packages revert to the old structure.

We hope you will take this feedback to heart and consider 1) reducing pricing (you can still take a small price increase on the old boarding price/structure!!), 2) changing the boarding structure away from these "packages" and "add-ons", and 3) focus on improving communication with your clients when making significant changes in the future.

Thank you for taking the time to read this and for the care your team has provided over the years.

Best of luck to PCP in the future.

:-(
Thank you very much for your kind review! We're glad you enjoyed your service.

My dog has been going to Pet Care Plus since he was a puppy. He goes to daycare and gets groomed. They are fantastic! Just like family! He's always so excited to get there and can't wait to get out the car!

My favorite nervous lady Florencia got groomed for the first time today, and the team at Pet Care Plus not only made her smell/look great but, most importantly, made her feel comfortable! Thanks to everyone who helped during her first spa day. We will be back!!

We have been using PCP for boarding for many years, we appreciated how there was an outdoor area. However, the boarding prices have increased suddenly by 50% for our dog (going from $95/day to $140/day) for the same services we were using before. This nickle and dimeing of "packages" is laughable and we will never be coming back, there are plenty of other options in the city.

Our first experience with Pet Care Plus was positive. The second, most recent time we boarded our dog with them was extremely concerning and we will not be bringing our dog here again.

She was supposed to be returned to us via their pet taxi service and she was not brought home during the window on that day. My calls and emails went unanswered, so, overnight we were not clear where she was. When I was able to get ahold of them the following morning there was no explanation of her whereabouts or why this happened.

Then, when she was returned we noticed a bloody wound on her neck and a patch where hair seemed to have been rubbed off. She had neither of this issues when we dropped her off nor in the photos they sent mid-stay. She also smelled like she had been sprayed with a strong deodorizer.

While I won’t speculate further here on what we think might have happened without proof, it’s all we’ve been left to do as Pet Care Plus did not make us aware of this injury and has not followed up at all about any of this despite making them aware several days ago.

We will likely look for an in-home dog sitter going forward as this was an awful experience we feel guilty having subjected our dog to, and found Pet Care Plus lacks the care, communication, and organization to be trusted with our pets going forward.

The Pet Care Plus team does such a great job with groomings for our dog - he always looks great and they take great care to make sure they are grooming him to our preferences. Highly recommend the PCP team for your grooming needs!

Love this place! Take my dog to daycare here, and a few things I love - they don’t require that you have to come 2-3x a week like many in Chicago. Just not realistic for us. Also, they have cameras! Something many in Chicago don’t.
Service is always so nice, and my dog who has not liked being dropped off at daycares in the past, LOVES coming here. She walks in and never looks back!
One thing I wish is that when she’s being boarded, they no longer send a daily report card unless you pay an extra fee which I don’t love.

Our dog attends Pet Care Plus when we both have to go into the office. He is a doodle so actually spends half of his day in the small dog side and half on the large dog side as it takes a while for him to warm up! The team at Pet Care Plus keeps the place clean and ensures all the pups are safe and happy. We get our dog groomed here too and it is so convenient and they do a great job every time! The shampoo and conditioner smell so great and they change it up with the season.

Our English springer spaniel has been going to PCP for over 5 years (twice/week) and it truly is his home away from home. The staff are amazing and always make us feel welcome. When we go on trips, we know that our pup will be in great hands when boarding. Could not be happier with the service, care, and amenities. 🐶❤️ …
The best daycare and boarding. My dog "Buster" loves it and their pool.
Amazing doggytopia!

I cannot express how much Sunni TRULY enjoys the staff and her pup friends at PCP. I know I always send her with extra things and she tends to be extra anxious, but every staff member at PCP makes me feel secure that she is in the best hands possible. I appreciate getting the "pupdates" which put my mind at ease when she can be a picky eater. Also, we have even run into a few daycare friends outside of daycare and become friends with them! I have and will continue to recommend Pet Care Plus to friends that ask - in a city where you have a lot of options, you only want the best for your fur babies <3

Honestly a really negative experience. My dogs had never been in any boarding or stayed with people I didn’t know when I left town until I booked them for a weekend at Pet Care Plus, so I was a bit nervous about leaving them for the first time. They told me a daily report card with photos came with the suite I reserved for them. The first day, the photo they included in the report card was not of my dog but a completely different dog. On the third day, the “report card” was completely pointless with a quick one word sentence and no photos of my dogs. I had also purchased a pool pass for the weekend, but noticed it had thunderstormed all weekend, so I asked if they got to use them upon picking them up. The person at the front desk had ensured me they got to use them, but I hadn’t seen any footage of them getting to use the pool all weekend. The camera access they give you does not show your dogs in their suites or many of the spaces they could be in-just the main play areas, where many of the times I did not see my dogs at all on all four screens.

I didn’t plan to leave a review, but I had brought all of this to their attention and given feedback shortly after their stay, and had no response. Just extremely disappointing for a $500 weekend and I would not recommend this place to anybody. There’s an extreme lack of transparency here and I would not trust them with my pets.

Staff is friendly and attentive. Responses to my inquiries are received within 24 hours or less.  Couple issues over the 2+ years my fur baby has attended were resolved with reasonable explanation and discussion for future actions. I’d recommend for boarding and day care. Watching my baby throughout the day is a comforting and fun experience.

We are having such a wonderful experience with Pet Care Plus! We have been bringing our puppy, Mickey, to daycare for about three months now and he loves it. The team provides excellent care and attention and their communication with us is outstanding. I highly recommend them!
Thanks for the 5-star review Amanda!

We brought our puppy, Pip, in for a bath. She is perfect (obviously), though we’re still working on the whole “not barking at absolutely everything” thing. But not at PCP! The moment she walked in, she was in love. Total spa mode.

Best part? I asked about shedding. They recommended the deshedding package — and for once, I didn’t feel upsold. I felt seen. Someone finally addressed our personal fur storm. And it was only a few extra bucks!

Pip came out looking like a show dog. We’ll be back for sure. Strongly recommend — even if it’s just for a bath and some ego-boosting for your pup. ❤️

Gina at Pet Care Plus is an absolute gem! She's been grooming my dog Riley for a while now, and every single visit has been a great experience. Riley always comes home looking adorable and smelling amazing -- but more importantly, he's happy and calm, which tells me he's in good hands. Gina is so gentle, professional, and clearly passionate about what she does. The entire staff at Pet Care Plus is incredibly kind and welcoming -- you can tell they truly care about the pets (and the humans!) who walk through their doors. I'm so thankful to have found a groomer and a team I can completely trust. Highly recommend!

Emily is a talented groomer who will take very good care of your dog. All of the staff I encountered were very kind and happy people. Overall great environment and my dog was happy when I picked him up.
Thank you Jessica!

We just completed our first day and had the best time. I’m a helicopter mom so I obviously watched the video feed all day and every single person was amazing and so attentive and loving toward my little dude. We’ve had experiences in the past where the daycare attendants weren’t super friendly with the dogs and this couldn’t have been a more opposite experience. We can’t wait to come back.

Five stars hands down. After a few disasters at other groomers, we found PCP  via a recommendation from a neighbor. Truly a god send for, our little Charlie (Cockapoo) , loves getting his monthly beauty treatment no more matting, tangles or bad hair days!!!

On three occasions our dog was left in a kennel after his grooming appointmen and no one attempted to notify us he was done. Most recently , he was left caged for over 45 minutes.

The last time we showed up for an appointment, we were turned away because you double booked the groomer.

On two other occasions, the groomer was late to work and I was left waiting in your lobby with my dog.

This was my first time using PCP for grooming.  I have to say the entire experience was underwhelming.  First, I had about 7-8 emails back and forth to get an appointment.  Even though I initially booked an online appointment, I received an email that it wasn't available.  Once the Client Services Coordinator (R) reached out to me, I then attempted to make the appointment by email with them.  Same thing happened, they offered me appointments and then they weren't available.  I should have just cut my losses then.  Booked the appointment for 8:00a.m., but it showed up in the portal as 9:00a.m. I emailed to ask about the discrepancy and was assured my appointment was at 8:00a.m.  Of course, I show up at 8:00a.m. and the first thing the desk person says is, "your appointment is at 9:00a.m.  I pull up the email and show her the confirmation from Senior Customer Representative (Z) confirming the 8:00a.m. appointment.  The groomer (G) had not arrived and was booked for with another customer.  She showed up about 20 minutes late and told me it would be 3-4 hours.  Utterly ridiculous.  Normally, it takes 2-3 hours to groom my dog.  So, I can imagine that he was just sitting in some crate waiting to be groomed.  After, the commensurate 3 hours, I called and he wasn't ready.  I called again at 4 hours because I had not heard from them regarding his finish time.  It takes another 30 minutes. So, he wasn't finished until 1:30p.m.  When they brought him to me, I was totally underwhelmed.  The haircut was awful, it was uneven and she sheared the bridge of his nose.  The blowout looked like something I could have done. He wasn't shiny and silky. They tout themselves as providing a spa like experience, but my experience was not spa like at all. The multiple emails to get an appointment, issues with the portal, less than welcoming front desk staff, late arriving groomer and bad haircut are all the reasons I will not return to PCP for any reason.  I debated whether or not to leave a review as a bad haircut grows out and I will NEVER return here.  However, I wanted to caution others. P.S. I tried to post pictures but kept getting error messages.

We have been taking our dog Ziggy here for over a year now. He used to love going there and seeing all his friends, but this past Wednesday during a normal daycare day he comes home limping and we found a tooth shaped hole in his right back leg as well as a 5 inch deep cut that had ripped all of his hair out.

After notifying pet care plus, I received a call the next day explaining that they had watched the footage and found out what happened. They told me and admitted that their daycare staff had known it happened, but didn’t report it. This is incredibly disappointing as like I said, we have been bringing him here for over a year..

Very nervous to bring him back. As I’m not sure that anything will be rectified.

We’ve been bringing our fur son, Tenley, to Pet Care Plus for grooming, and every single visit has been fantastic. Tenley is a shedding Husky-German Shepherd mix with a bit of an anxious streak, but the grooming team always treats him with so much care and patience.

They do an incredible job—he comes home clean, soft, smelling amazing, and looking like a total stud. They handle his coat like pros, and you can tell he feels comfortable and safe with them. It’s not easy finding a groomer who gets it right with a dog like Tenley, but Pet Care Plus absolutely does.

Thank you for keeping our guy looking and feeling his best. He walks out of every appointment like he knows he looks good!

We have been bringing our dog Pippin to Pet Care Plus for the past 4 months for daycare and we have been so happy with the care from the team! Remy and Zoey are both amazing coordinators and are always so incredibly helpful. The facility is flexible with daycare bookings and extremely responsive via email, text, and phone. Absolute favorite things about this daycare I haven't found at others; pool is AMAZING if your dog is a swimmer, camera access is so fun to peek in on your dog during the day, and their extended evening pickup hours are so so appreciated.

Lastly, we had an incident where our dog was aggressive towards another which the team communicated to us quickly and thoroughly and partnered with us in determining best next steps for our dog to ensure the safety of others. We never felt attacked / put on the spot throughout this experience and I just so appreciate everything about this daycare :)

Emily, Miriam and everyone on the team at Pet Care Plus are completely wonderful. We’ve been taking Copper there for over 5 years and have only had positive experiences. Copper always looks and smells so good after his grooming appointments too!

I have been bringing Ernie in for grooming with Miriam for the last 8 months and couldn’t be happier. She is extremely friendly (to me and my pup) and does a great job with his haircut and bath, and he’s usually done in 3-4 hours. All of the staff at Pet Care Plus are friendly, efficient and informative. The pricing is in line with other groomers, the facility is clean and they offer daycare, boarding and taxi services (I will be signing Ernie up for daycare soon). I love knowing that Ernie is in good hands when I drop him off. Thanks Miriam & team!
We have been going to Gina for grooming for over a year. She is fantastic. So glad we found Pet Care Plus. I recommend them to everyone in the area
Miriam is wonderful and always does a great job grooming my pup!

We take our morkie Frankie here for grooming and both Gina and Miriam have consistently taken great care of our girl. We’ve been coming here since she was a puppy (she’s 5 now) and wouldn’t go anywhere else!
Pet Care Plus always exceeds our expectations.  The staff is consistently professional and courteous.
Consistent quality grooming. We’ve trusted this place for years!

This boarding facility is clean. Extremely so. The staff are professional,caring,empathetic individuals perfectly suited to their roles. This is NOT a job or work for them,they actually enjoy their time on shift and they enjoy your “children”. I highly recommend this facility to anyone having to leave their pet in the care of others. Their rates are extremely reasonable,their optional services divine. Try them,i promise you will be a repeat client.
Miriam is the best dog groomer we’ve ever had. I'd recommend her to anyone looking for a kind, talented groomer. Love her!

I recently got my dog groomed here and had an amazing experience!!! My dog was very clearly anxious when we arrived and the groomer (who I believe was named Emily) was super understanding of his anxiety and did her best to get him to warm up to her. I initially had asked them to shave him down and during the appointment she gave me a call that shaving down a golden retriever damages their coat which I had no idea about. I took her advice and he looked so cute afterwards. They also sent a little postcard to thank us for coming in which I loved
Thank you so much we really appreciate the review.
We love Pet Care Plus! Sammy had a fabulous spa day today! We are very appreciative of the care, attentiveness, and love Sammy always receives!

We love PCP! More importantly, Nell the Lakeland Terrier loves PCP. The staff is helpful and accommodating and kind - they obviously love dogs and we are always confident that they will carefully follow feeding instructions and take the best care of each of their charges, according to each
one's needs.
Phenomenal care and and attention to detail. My pet loved everyday during her overnight boarding stay
Great service and grooming by Gina!

I used to love this place, the people are nice and the facility is very large and nice. Unfortunately we took our dog out because it started smelling badly every time we went to pick her up and then one time I had paid for my dog to get a bath, which is a pricey luxury we budget for once in a while and one of the employees loudly asked me to leave a tip. I am happy to tip when  I have it in my budget but not everyone has gotten inflation adjusted raises and my family is on a tight budget. The prices of all their services went up and I wanted to stay but to demand a tip publicly made me feel shamed into it and want to never return again.
